options.content: **Data since ${go_live}.** There is no backfill: charts start empty at go-live and fill as the collector runs. All times are UTC.

panels.title: Most popular military aircraft (unique pilots, last 7 days)
panels.description: v1 card 65, rebuilt from v1's rule. Counts distinct pilots (CIDs) per military aircraft type over completed flights that ended in the selected time range (default last 7 days). A type counts as military only if it is in v1's card 65 code list (aircraft_type.in_v1_card65_list, 225 exact codes; v1's wildcard entries never matched anything and are not used). The share is each type's pilots divided by the sum of the per-type pilot counts, so a pilot who flew two types is counted under both and the shares add up to 100%. Flights still connected are left out. Differs from the broader aircraft_type.is_military flag by seven codes: EA18, EUFI, FA18, HAWK, K35R, KC10, KC30.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.aircraft, t.pilots, t.flights,
       round(100.0 * t.pilots / sum(t.pilots) OVER (), 2) AS "% of pilots"
FROM (
  SELECT f.aircraft_icao AS aircraft, count(DISTINCT f.cid) AS pilots, count(*) AS flights
  FROM flight_ext f
  JOIN aircraft_type a ON a.icao = f.aircraft_icao
  WHERE a.in_v1_card65_list
    AND f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY f.aircraft_icao
) t
ORDER BY t.pilots DESC, t.flights DESC, t.aircraft

panels.title: Most popular RAAFv routes (last month)
panels.description: v1 card 78 ('What were the most popular RAAFv routes last month?', edited 07-10-2025). RAAFv flights are those whose flight-plan remarks contain RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG (case-insensitive), not an aircraft-type list. Window is the last month (UTC), not 7 days. Each session is counted once (v1 de-duplicated on callsign and logon time). Shows share of RAAFv flights and pilots; top 25 routes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.route_label AS route,
       count(*) AS total_flights,
       count(DISTINCT r.cid) AS unique_pilots,
       round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 2) AS "% of RAAFv flights",
       round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT r.cid) / sum(count(DISTINCT r.cid)) OVER (), 2) AS "% of RAAFv pilots"
FROM (
  SELECT f.cid, f.route_label,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.session_id ORDER BY f.end_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
    AND f.departure <> '' AND f.arrival <> ''
) r
WHERE r.rn = 1
GROUP BY r.route_label
ORDER BY total_flights DESC, unique_pilots DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Hours flown by RAAFv aircraft per week (last 14 weeks)
panels.description: v1 card 66 ('Hours flown by RAAFv aircraft per week', edited 18-10-2025). RAAFv flights are those whose flight-plan remarks contain RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG (case-insensitive), not an aircraft-type list. Airborne hours per UTC week (v1 summed time online); last 98 days. Weeks start on Monday (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       round((sum(f.airborne_minutes) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "RAAFv hours"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: RAAFv flights (last 7 days)
panels.description: v1 card 142 ('Show RAAFVIRTUAL flights last 7 days', edited 22-09-2025). RAAFv flights are those whose flight-plan remarks contain RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG (case-insensitive). Window is logon time in the last 7 days (UTC). One row per distinct callsign, CID, name, aircraft type, route, remarks and logon time; flights without a filed departure and arrival are not listed (v3 flight gate); newest 500. Names and CIDs are shown by decision (ADR-009, ADR-019).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT f.callsign, f.cid, f.name,
       upper(btrim(f.aircraft_icao)) AS aircraft_type,
       f.departure, f.arrival, f.remarks, f.logon_time
FROM flight f
WHERE f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
  AND f.logon_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY f.logon_time DESC, f.callsign
LIMIT 500

panels.title: RAAFv flights by aircraft type (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 143 ('RAAFV flights by acft type - last 30 days', edited 18-10-2025). RAAFv = remarks contain RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG. Flights ending in the last 30 days (UTC), per aircraft type: distinct sessions, airborne minutes and hours (v1 summed total_enroute_time_minutes; v3 uses airborne minutes) and average airborne hours per flight. Top 50 types by hours. Shown as a table, as in v1.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(f.aircraft_icao, ''), '(none)') AS aircraft_type,
       count(DISTINCT f.session_id) AS total_flights,
       round(sum(COALESCE(f.airborne_minutes, 0))) AS total_airborne_minutes,
       round(sum(COALESCE(f.airborne_minutes, 0)) / 60.0, 2) AS total_airborne_hours,
       round(avg(COALESCE(f.airborne_minutes, 0)) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_airborne_hours_per_flight
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_airborne_hours DESC, aircraft_type
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Most popular RAAFv aircraft last month (flights)
panels.description: v1 card 161 ('What were the most popular RAAFv aircraft last month (flights)?', edited 07-10-2025). RAAFv = remarks contain RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG. Flights by aircraft type with logon in the last 30 days (UTC), one count per session (v1 de-duplicated on callsign and logon time, keeping the latest row). Top 25 types; the share column is of all RAAFv flights.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.aircraft AS aircraft,
       count(*) AS "Flights",
       round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 2) AS "% of RAAFv flights"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(upper(btrim(f.aircraft_icao)), ''), '(none)') AS aircraft,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.session_id ORDER BY f.end_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM flight f
  WHERE f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
    AND f.logon_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
) t
WHERE t.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.aircraft
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, t.aircraft
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Flights flown by RAAFv aircraft per week (last 14 weeks)
panels.description: v1 card 184 ('Flights flown by RAAFv aircraft per week', edited 02-01-2026). RAAFv = remarks contain RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG. Flights ending in each UTC week (weeks start Monday; v1 labelled the week start 'week_end'), last 98 days. Shown oldest to newest as bars; the current week is partial.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(*) AS "RAAFv flights"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
